arguments.message: Yes – Meridian can automatically push a recurring export to a cloud‑storage destination on a weekly schedule. Just go to **Settings → Data → Scheduled exports**, set the recurrence to **weekly**, connect your cloud‑storage account via the one‑time OAuth connection, and save the schedule. Each run will create a new file in the connected storage (it won’t overwrite previous files) and you’ll see a history of the runs in the scheduled‑exports screen.
